items.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.description: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. items.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
items.description: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. items.title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
items.description: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. items.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
items.description: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. items.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
items.description: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. items.description: In many practical deployments of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD), the server processes data in batches. items.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers

items.title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
items.description: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. items.title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer

items.title: SATFRONT: Detecting Atmospheric Fronts with Satellite Data using Machine Learning
items.description: Atmospheric fronts are associated with much of the high-impact weather in the mid-latitudes, yet their identification and classification remain largely manual and subjective. items.name: Cost-Aware Stopping for Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization: When Does One-Step Lookahead Suffice?
items.title: Cost-Aware Stopping for Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization: When Does One-Step Lookahead Suffice?
items.description: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization (BO) evaluates candidates in resumable increments but usually stops at a budget or convergence test. We maximize a budget-free utility, the best observed score minus a cost per increment, with a one-step lookahead: advance the candidate with the largest expected improvement (EI) under a fixed surrogate, and stop once no EI exceeds the cost. items.title: PersonaChatBench: Evaluating Chat Assistants with Diverse Simulated Users
